firstContext: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/11/4), with 6 wave-4 and 2 wave-5 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.

finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Farid Ahmed ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
